content: Nephropathy and retinopathy are significant complications observed in young individuals with Type 1 diabetes. The American Diabetes Association (ADA) emphasizes the importance of managing diabetic retinopathy effectively. Retinal photography can serve as a valuable tool to aid in screening for diabetic retinopathy. However, programs that utilize retinal photography should prioritize ensuring that patients receive prompt referrals for comprehensive ophthalmologic examinations when abnormalities are detected or further evaluation is required.
